overall_summary: The channel shows early potential in relationship and family dynamics, particularly with the 'Wife Emotional Video' (1,610 views) outperforming all other topics significantly. However, overall sample size is low, making broader pattern recognition preliminary.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video (1610 views) and Maa/Father/Family shorts consistently gain baseline views compared to niche sister or brother shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more core content on spouse, parent-child, and deep relationship bonds.

weak_patterns.pattern: Low-performing duplicate or overlapping sibling content
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video posted twice yielded low views (17 and 125).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid repetitive topics within short timeframes and diversify relationship angles.
